output.overview: Two concepts for a document translator, grounded in the supplied transcripts and frame descriptions. All proposed visuals use logo-free app interfaces, text and animation, with no humans or body parts.
searchNotes: Only two sources were supplied: one directly relevant and one adjacent. No external search was performed.
No frame images were attached. Evidence comes from transcripts and indexed frame descriptions; these do not establish video openings or whole-video compliance.
Suggested hooks and storyboards are proposed creative concepts, not source quotes. Supplied metrics do not establish why either video performed.

qualifications.reason: Addresses listening to imported documents, a concrete part of the product promise, but provides no evidence of translation. Its import-to-play sequence transfers to demonstrating the listening step.
qualifications.hook: Source caption: “Listen to documents.” Opening timing is unknown.
qualifications.title: Listen to documents

qualifications.reason: Demonstrates the same need: translating a document into another language and listening to the translated text. Its text-to-playback sequence transfers directly.
qualifications.hook: Source caption: “Translate and listen.” Opening timing is unknown.
qualifications.title: Translate and listen

angles.title: From Page to Playback
angles.label: Transformation demo
angles.description: Show one document moving from unfamiliar text to a readable translation, then to audio playback.
angles.whyItFits: Makes both parts of the promise visible in one continuous demonstration.
angles.evidence: translate-1 says an English document is translated into Spanish and read aloud. Its frame description at 6 seconds lists translated Spanish text and a playback button.
angles.suggestedHook: What if this foreign-language page could become something you understand—and hear?
angles.visualDirection: Animate a logo-free document interface from English text to Spanish text, then activate its playback button. Use only typography, interface elements and an audio waveform; no humans or body parts.

angles.title: Let the Document Speak
angles.label: Workflow demo
angles.description: Lead with listening, then reveal the simple path: import a document, choose a translation language and press play.
angles.whyItFits: Connects a familiar document-listening workflow with the product's language translation benefit.
angles.evidence: read-1 says to import a document, choose a reading voice and press play; its 5-second frame description lists a document library and playback controls. translate-1 explicitly describes listening to translated text.
angles.suggestedHook: Your document. Your language. Press play.
angles.visualDirection: Use a logo-free app screen with an animated document import, language selection and playback controls. Indicate actions with interface state changes, without hands, people or body parts.

storyboard.title: From Page to Playback
storyboard.premise: A 24-second interface demonstration turns an English document into Spanish text and spoken audio.
storyboard.hook: What if you could understand every book?

scenes.visual: English document text fills a logo-free app screen. Overlay: “What if you could understand every book?” Typography only; no humans or body parts.
scenes.voiceover: What if you could understand every book?

scenes.visual: A document appears in the app library through animation. A language selector changes to Spanish. Logo-free interface only; no humans or body parts.
scenes.voiceover: Import your document and choose the language you prefer.

scenes.visual: The document view changes to Spanish text with a visible playback button. Logo-free interface only; no humans or body parts.
scenes.voiceover: Read the translated text in your chosen language.

scenes.visual: Playback activates and a simple waveform animates beside the translated text. End card: “Understand books in any language. Translate and listen.” No logos, humans or body parts.
scenes.voiceover: Then press play and listen. Understand books in any language.

storyboard.callToAction: Import a document. Translate and listen.
